sentences.text:
Vijay Kumar Kashyap vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home
Lko. on 13 February, 2024

Author: Karunesh Singh Pawar
Bench: Karunesh Singh Pawar
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench
?Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc-Lko:13119
Court No. - 14
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 1321 of 2024
Applicant :- Vijay Kumar Kashyap
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko.

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Counsel for Applicant :- Sudhir Kumar Rai,Dhirendra Vikram Singh Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Karunesh Singh Pawar,J.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned AGA for the State and perused the record.
It is alleged in the FIR that daughter of the informant Chandravati was married with the applicant.
The applicant under influence of liquor used to brutally beat the deceased.
Several times the informant tried to persuade the applicant, however, all his efforts went in vain.
On 27.03.2023 at about 8:00 pm in the night, the applicant badly beaten the deceased in front of their children.
On 28.03.2023, when Shiva and Satyam (children of the deceased) after waking up did not find their mother at home, a report of missing was lodged.
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated.
Cause of death is asphyxia as a result of antemortem drowning.
The case is of circumstantial evidence.
There is no eye witness of the incident and ingredients of Section 107/306 Vijay Kumar Kashyap vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko.

1 IPC are not attracted.
It is further submitted that the applicant is languishing in jail since 03.06.2023 without having any criminal antecedent.
There is no possibility of the applicant of fleeing away after being released from jail or tampering with the witnesses.
In case the applicant is enlarged on bail, he shall not misuse the liberty of bail.

Per contra, learned AGA has submitted that sons of the deceased Shiva and Satyam in their statements under Section 161 Cr.P.C. have stated that on 27.03.2023, his father came heavily drunk and he started beating their mother with rope; in anger, the deceased broke her bangles and took out her jewelries and she kept on weeping and thereafter they went to sleep.
It has been further submitted that when they woke up, they did not find their mother at home.
It has been further submitted by the learned AGA that dead body of the deceased was found in Sai River.
The deceased died due to atrocities committed by the applicant and the testimonies of two sons of the applicant are very natural and cannot be disbelieved.
The complicity of the applicant is evident.

On due consideration to the statements of two sons of the applicant, so also the ingredients of Section 306 IPC, prima facie complicity of the applicant is made out and hence, I am not inclined to enlarge the applicant on bail.

Accordingly, the bail application of the applicant Vijay Kumar Kashyap involved in Case Crime/FIR No. 86/2023, under Sections 498A/306 IPC, Police Station - Asoha, District - Unnao is hereby rejected.
Let a copy of this order be transmitted to the learned trial court who shall expedite the trial within a period of one year from the date of receipt of copy of this order.

Liberty is granted to the applicant to revive his bail plea once the statements of the witnesses are complete.
Order Date :- 13.2.2024 R.C.
